label: Insect Glaive
note: MH4U endgame Insect Glaive is raw-first. Star Knight is the common full-set template (Sharpness +1, Challenger +2, Steady Hand/Razor Sharp, Rodeo God), while optimized mixed sets add Honed Blade (Sharpness +1 + Attack Up (L)), Weakness Exploit, and often HG Earplugs; Anubis, True Fatalis Dyaus, and Bounding Dalamadur are common glaives. This preset assumes Sharpness +1 and models Honed Blade's +20 true raw through attackUp; Honed Blade is not modeled as a composite skill, and Razor Sharp, Challenger +2's conditional +25 raw/+20% affinity, Weakness Exploit's +5 weak-zone hitzone, Rodeo God, HG Earplugs, and kinsect/extract buffs are unmodeled. Element Attack Up is not an IG priority. MH4U sharpness raw is 1.05 green / 1.20 blue / 1.32 white / 1.45 purple, not MHFU's values.
